sourceRefs.locator: Editorial introduction on the sixteenth-century copies of the Latin text; heading and articles I (chosen citizens), V (houses, vineyards and avenues for complaint) and VIII (officers entitled to seize goods, working cattle and field labourers).

labels.de: Bürger in der Versammlung von León
labels.en: Townspeople at the gathering in León

note.de: Alfons IX. ließ in León die Beteiligung gewählter Bürger und Regeln zum Schutz von Häusern, Weinbergen und Zugvieh festhalten. Der Punkt markiert die Stadt.
note.en: At León, Alfonso IX recorded the participation of chosen citizens and provisions for protecting homes, vineyards and working cattle. The marker locates the city.
